persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.
bank.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
bank.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
bank.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

messages.text: Could you make a post for a little houseplant shop, with lots of lush potted houseplants? I have a soft spot for little plant shops, so I’m probably overthinking how to explain this. It’s for an Instagram feed, and the headline should be exactly “Bring home some green”. I’d like a clean cream background behind all the plants. I’m a little worried my rambling makes this sound more complicated than it is. There should be no other text besides that headline.
